Unexpectedly good find
Jul 2023 • Couples
The bar staff were excellent and friendly . We asked for, and they gave us, an in depth history of Vietnam, its language and places to visit ( and not visit at this time of year) in Vietnam as well as suggestions if we ever visit again. Lovely ambience and background speakeasy vibe. Fab selection of whiskeys and cocktails and a wide selection of good wines- (they do happy hours for 50% but check the times ) and non alcoholic drinks also available. Hidden away down the back of an alley nearish the Saigon centre, ( with staff outside and along the alley to guide us - it was perfectly safe anyway) we found this hidden treasure. Food menu looks excellent though we came late to the bar so did not eat. Barman has excellent English and one of the bar girls, though a little shy, soon got chatting. There is live music on Friday and Saturday early evening too! What a little jewel to find! Tad more expensive than local bars as mostly imported but the choice and quality on offer was good.

Cocktails at a truly international standard.
Jul 2018 • Solo
Secluded cocktail bar down an alley on Pasteur street - can be hard to find! Welcoming, relaxed and very stylish interior. Impressive back-bar boasts a wide variety of international spirits, including Scotches, American and Japanese whiskies and various deluxe gins. Skillful cocktail preparation at a truly international standard of execution and precision. Menu selection focusing on the cocktail classics. Gin Martini was well-balanced and expertly chilled via ice stir in a yarai glass. A bourbon Manhattan was deliciously dry and crisp with a subtle spicing of Angostura, although I would have preferred a Luxardo Maraschino cherry rather than the bright red version used. Lastly the bartender kindly made me a Martinez using Genever rather than London Dry Gin, which was an excellent drink with rich, warm flavours. Staff very kind and welcoming. Decent selection of food also on offer. Excellent choice for a very high-quality cocktail experience in HCMC.

Number One Cocktail Bar in Saigon
May 2018 • Friends
The Alley is aptly named, like so many hidden gems in Saigon it pays to know what you're looking for and where you're going. Luckily there is an un-assuming sign, but down a fairly dark alley we encountered a gentleman, who opened a door and pushed aside a curtain to one of the coolest speak easy concepts I have seen. 

The clientele mid week were largely native, and there was live music and a beautifully appointed bar. As a large group of under-dressed Americans they graciously directed us to the upstairs lounge that is both air conditioned and has a glass partition to maintain the integrity of a an otherwise quaint spot that would be perfect for an intimate cocktail. 

The locally made craft beers, extensive whisk(e)y selection, as well as the exquisitely esoteric and classic cocktails were a welcome find. From "the Mekong Delta" to a Vieux Carre, or a fifteen year old single malt, this was the most intriguing and exceptional cocktail bars in the city. 

Like any good cocktail bar, patience is key. Good things come to those who wait.

Perfect Saturday Evening Cocktail In The City
Jan 2018 • Couples
We found this place purely by chance after a long Saturday in the city. We were trying to find HCMC's best cocktail and this place did not disappoint! It's tucked away on a side street/alley off Pasteur so keep your eyes peeled. You'll know you've found it as there will be a gentleman outside the door to greet and usher you in to this cool bar.

Everything about this place is perfect for a classy drink as a couple, on a date or with friends. The crowd is a classy mix of Vietnamese and International guests. The best seats are those around the edge of the bar where you can watch the bartender/owner display an impressive range of cocktail making skills and theatre as he beautifully puts your drink together. The drinks mostly focus on a list of 40 'classics' although there are some originals in there too. We stayed for several during happy hour and each drink was beautifully constructed in flavour and appearance. The prices were incredibly reasonable when compared to any of the 'sky bars' in HCMC where you'll pay a fortune for a very average drink. If you get a chance to chat to the owner then do so - a super interesting guy who is passionate about his bar and about making cocktails.
